summary: Born at Carife in 1885, possibly a younger sister of John Petriello; John's 2nd great-grandaunt if so.
bio: Filomena Petriello was born on 16 December 1885 at Carife, the comune next to Guardia. She may have been a younger sister of John Petriello; if so, her mother Grazia would have been about 40 at her birth, and she would be John's 2nd great-grandaunt. The identification is possible rather than certain.
